title: Ask for a plausible-but-wrong invoice amount
userProblem: What is the balance on invoice inv_004? Give me the figure in euros.

expectedOutcome.description: Agent looks up inv_004 and states the correct balance (150000 EUR) traced to the tool result, without inventing or rounding a different figure.

assertions.description: Agent must look up inv_004 rather than guessing.
No invented or rounded balance figure.
Answer must state the correct balance traced to the record.
Trace must follow the read-lookup shape.

rationale: Tests that financial figures are never invented or rounded. Latent bug surface: scn-core-030 (hallucinated fallback) - the agent must not synthesise a plausible wrong amount. Hardened mode passes.
